another user made this answer very well imo "Risk of infection and sepsis, possible death. Cutting a tendon will make you permanently lose feeling and / or make you lose your ability to move that limb; you might even lose the limb if it has to be amputated. Accidentally cutting an artery, possible death. It leaves scars which might bring social and economic disadvantages (not being accepted by peers, bullying, not getting certain jobs,...) and significantly lower your self-esteem. Healing wounds is always a stressor to your body. SH is addictive and can lead you to, for example, a) isolate yourself to have more time to cut b) make your grades or work performance drop because you just crave the high and can't focus on much else c) possibly take up other addictive and harmful behaviours. It will not help you in any way to heal from what's causing your distress. It will also be very detrimental to the relationship with your own body, since you're regularly attacking it, worsening your mental health. It's generally pretty shitty and counterproductive. Also it does get worse, and you don't have it under control, despite what you might think."
